title: 12 Best Cooking Classes in Koh Samui
description: Discover the 12 best cooking classes in Koh Samui for 2026. Learn authentic Thai cuisine, explore local markets, and master signature dishes with expert chefs on your next island getaway.

places.name: Samui Institute of Thai Culinary Arts (SITCA)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mastering the 'Tom Yum Goong' (Spicy Shrimp Soup) and 'Pad Thai' for an authentic Thai start.

places.name: Chef Hom's Thai Cooking Class
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order His green curry paste from scratch is legendary, along with 'Massaman Curry' and 'Mango Sticky Rice'.

places.name: Island Organics Samui Thai Cooking School
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any dish featuring their homegrown produce, especially the 'Panang Curry' or 'Cashew Nut Chicken'.

places.name: Baan Thai Cookery School
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order They teach an excellent 'Green Curry with Chicken' and a delightful 'Spring Roll' recipe.

places.name: Anantara Bophut Koh Samui Resort - Spice Spoons
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on regional Southern Thai specialties like 'Gaeng Phet Gai' (Red Curry with Chicken) and exquisite 'Phad See Ew'.

places.name: The Farm Samui
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their healthy 'Larb Gai' (Minced Chicken Salad) and fresh 'Papaya Salad' are outstanding and packed with flavor.

places.name: Melia Koh Samui - The Level Cooking Class
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their rendition of 'Hor Mok Talay' (Steamed Seafood Curry) and unique curry creations are highly recommended.

places.name: Four Seasons Resort Koh Samui
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Request to learn complex dishes like 'Gaeng Kiew Wan Gai' (Green Curry) with a focus on homemade curry paste, or 'Mee Krob'.

places.name: Six Senses Samui - Dining on the Rocks Cooking Class
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on their signature dishes, which often feature fresh local seafood and unique presentations, like a deconstructed 'Tom Kha Gai'.

places.name: Pru Chaweng Thai Cooking Class (Pru Restaurant)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Pad Krapow' (Stir-fried Basil) and 'Tom Kha Gai' (Galangal Coconut Soup) are fantastic, truly capturing local flavors.

places.name: Banyan Tree Samui - The Living Room Cooking Class
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mastering the art of 'Pla Nueng Manao' (Steamed Fish with Lime and Chili) and a fragrant 'Tom Kha Talay'.

places.name: Rocky's Boutique Resort - Cooking Class
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Gaeng Keow Wan Goong' (Green Prawn Curry) and 'Som Tum' (Papaya Salad) are taught exceptionally well.
